records.text: heads up, union analytics looks stalled -- no first project after a week
handing off Union Analytics to whoever has bandwidth this week :slightly_smiling_face:

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Just wanted to say hi and see how things are going with Wrenfield so far. Reply whenever, no rush.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Union Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:61a63bb5, email:4b1e518d), no tickets, no project, no invite. Fully silent accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days; Pro plan and active subscription give some upside.

draft.subject: Getting your first project started
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

I wanted to check in since your Wrenfield workspace has been quiet so far. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the easiest place to begin 
invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time once you're ready.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that's in the way.

Best,
Nadia
